ports.note: Both are required: the decision is about these points against that area.

ontology.note: Asserts the OGC predicate the kept set answers to (sfWithin, with boundary points being sfTouches), whether boundary points were kept, and the three counts. The predicate itself is pointRelation in src/spatial-predicates.ts, shared with the coverage check, the map, input data, the raster mask and catchments.

changes.description: Preview counts what the clip will keep before it runs -- inside, exactly on the outline, outside, and records with no usable location -- and the outline setting moves records between kept and set aside as it is ticked. Computed with the step's own function, so what is previewed is what it does. Where the area or the points only exist after a run, it says so rather than implying nothing falls inside.

evidence.note: The membership test is the one the coverage check and the map already use, and the lab checks it there. What is new here is the operation and its receipt, not the arithmetic. 0.9.0: tests/clip-points-preview.browser.mjs (3 of 4 kept with one exactly on the outline; unticking moves it to set aside and the count to 2 of 4; ticking returns it). Chromium, 2026-11-23.
